title: Rav Huna Zuta
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: In Beitzah 29b: Rava bar Rav Huna Zuta; Dikdukei Soferim reads Rabbah, and so it is in Ketubot 69a, Rabbah bar Rav Huna Zuta. Hyman infers from Beitzah that the Rava/Rabbah mentioned is the son of Rav Huna without further designation, agreeing with Yuchasin, since Rav Huna was a short man.

notes.text: The inference identifies the father called Huna Zuta with Rav Huna without further designation; it does not turn the entry’s Huna into his own son. The William Davidson digital Beitzah 29b has Rava bar Rav Huna Zutei and Ketubot 69a has Rabbah bar Rav Huna Zuta; the identification and short-stature argument remain Hyman’s.
